on_screen_text.text: This man sent an email to ICE after the deaths of Alex Pretti and Renee Good.
@NPR David Streever was on vacation with his daughter when his doorbell camera back home recorded two DHS officers standing on his front porch:

Why? Because a few months prior, after the murder of U.S. citizens Renee Good and Alex Pretti in Minnesota, Streever had sent an email to Todd Lyons, the ICEs former acting director, criticizing Trumps immigration crackdown:
Later, after Streever landed in New York and checked into an airport hotel for the night, another DHS agent tracked him down. The agent even left a business card with the hotels front desk.
"One powerless citizen yelled into the void with a stern email to the former director of this agency six months ago," Streever told NPR: "And now there's agents at his door."

central_claim: The Trump administration used federal agents from DHS and ICE to intimidate a private citizen who sent a critical email, constituting an abuse of power.
intended_effect: To alarm viewers about what is portrayed as authoritarian behavior and an abuse of government power under Donald Trump.
